description:
## 2.1.4 (2026-11-20)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix scrolling comments disappearing when overlap prevention is turned off during playback
* **nicoid:** Fix deferred scrolling comments appearing partway across the screen instead of entering from the right edge
* **nicoid:** Prevent comments already on screen from unexpectedly changing speed or vertical position when additional comments arrive or display settings change
* **nicoid:** Fix scrolling comments becoming stuck in crowded scenes by briefly waiting for space, then allowing controlled overlap without discarding comments

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Significantly reduce scrolling comment processing overhead by indexing comment timestamps and avoiding redundant full-list scans
* **nicoid:** Optimize lane collision calculations to reduce unnecessary overlap when space is available while preserving dense danmaku in crowded scenes
* **nicoid:** Spread large bursts of comment preparation and placement across successive frames, preserving comment order and retaining pending comments without dropping them
* **nicoid:** Reduce comment rendering overhead by sharing playback-time samples, reusing drawing resources, and reducing time spent holding the SurfaceHolder lock
* **nicoid:** Reduce allocations when drawing video statistics icons in lists and optimize first-line text extraction
* **nicoid:** Reuse Ambient Mode opacity gradients when only sampled colors change, avoiding unnecessary shader creation
* **nicoid:** Reduce unnecessary wake-ups between independent search and ranking page requests
* **nicoid:** Optimize Media3 playback diagnostics by using the public player interface while preserving existing playback behavior
* **nicoid:** Clarify overlap-prevention descriptions in Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese

release_notes:
## 1.9.5 (2026-10-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **nicoid:** Fix a crash when changing playback quality.
* **nicoid:** Fix popup player movement bounds.
* **nicoid:** Fix playback controls being positioned outside the visible area in tablet mode. ([#75](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/75))
* **nicoid:** Fix a crash when updating the displayed playback time.

### 🔧 Improvements

* **nicoid:** Improve playback quality switching in normal and popup players. Switch between available video tracks without reloading the stream when supported, while preserving playback position and paused state.
* **nicoid:** Preserve the current playback position and playback state when a stream reload is required for a quality change.
* **nicoid:** Keep user selections synchronized across Nico Report tabs.
* **nicoid:** Improve Google Cast startup diagnostics, including playback request submission and results, to investigate playback remaining on “Preparing.” ([#70](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/70))
